character_creation.title: Character Creation
character_creation.description: Fill in the initial data to create your identity.
character_creation.select_birthdate: Please enter a valid date of birth
character_creation.gender_hint: Sets the base body. Face, hair and clothes come later.
character_creation.name_hint_first: Type your first name. Enter moves to the last name.
character_creation.name_hint_last: Now the last name. Enter confirms.
character_creation.birth_hint: Arrows or mouse wheel adjust, ← → switches column. Enter creates the character.
character_creation.origin_hint: Type to search or scroll the list. Arrows pick.
character_creation.arrival_hint: What brought you to Los Santos? Arrows choose. Enter creates the character.
character_creation.birth_hint_next: Arrows or mouse wheel adjust, ← → switches column. Enter continues.
character_creation.arrival_plane: A one-way ticket and no plan to go back.
character_creation.arrival_container: A promise of work. And a man who charged a lot to bring me.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust the look and feel.
settings.accent_color_description: Pick a color for UI highlights. Reset to the server default at any time.

admin.no_permission: You don't have permission to open the panel.
admin.title: Multichar
admin.subtitle: Branding and landing options
admin.brand_title_hint: Large name on the landing screen
admin.brand_logo_hint: If set, uses the image instead of the text
admin.show_continue_hint: Jump straight into the last played character
admin.slots_hint: Default for everyone and the cap for granting extra. Adjust per player in the list.
admin.stages_hint: Where each character appears and its animation. Filled in the order of occupied slots.
admin.no_stages: No positions set, using the automatic row from config.
admin.heading: Rot
admin.slots_default_hint: Slots for players without their own override
admin.music_url_hint: YouTube link or a file in the resource sounds/ folder
admin.music_volume_hint: Starting volume in %; each player can pause
admin.music_cues_hint: The link above plays on the menu. Each creation phase can have its own track, with a smooth crossfade; empty keeps the previous phase track.
admin.arrivals_hint: How a new character arrives in Los Santos. The player picks through the question "What brought you to Los Santos?".
admin.arrival_destination_hint: Where the player ends the scene. Bus, taxi and car stop at the roadside closest to it.
admin.arrival_plane_hint: The GTA Online intro cutscene; then the player goes to the destination.
admin.arrival_test_hint: Plays the saved scene. You will end up at the destination.
admin.intro_hint: Title screen before the characters: city shots in a loop with the brand and "Press Enter". After Enter the camera flies down to the stage.
admin.intro_enabled_hint: Off or without shots, players go straight to the characters.
admin.intro_save_first: Save before testing or framing shots.
admin.intro_shots_hint: Add shot opens a free camera in game: frame it, zoom with the scroll wheel and press Enter.
admin.intro_empty: No shots yet. Without shots there is no intro.
admin.ambience_hint: Apply to the intro, the characters and creation, only for whoever is on this screen. Entering the game brings back the server time.
admin.arrival_container_hint: Stand where the character steps out of the container, with your back to where it will appear. Good spot: the port.
admin.arrival_track_hint: YouTube link, direct audio link or @resource/path, like the tracks in the Start screen tab. Plays from the reveal to the end of the story. Empty = the arrival track goes on.
